file_decisions.evidence: The product metadata test now verifies that no unsupported shippingDetails claim is emitted and that the organization policy links to the published returns page. Current responsive and local-search assertions are retained.
The synchronized branded shell is retained. Page-specific discovery metadata remains the responsibility of route SEO components and the generated public overlay.
Product pages now add organization-level MerchantReturnPolicy JSON-LD that links to the real conditional policy without declaring a fabricated universal return window.
The dirty prose mixes current no-advance COD with historical INR 50 booking-advance behavior. Legal copy must not select a payment model while the payment bundle remains blocked.
The historical booking-advance refund/forfeiture terms are coupled to the unresolved payment model and are not independently safe to publish.

structured_data_invariants: Product JSON-LD does not fabricate aggregate ratings.
Product JSON-LD does not advertise unsupported shippingDetails.
Organization policy JSON-LD links to https://vibe4you.in/returns.
The structured policy does not claim a universal return window or return fee.
production_claim: No legal policy, payment behavior, deployment, service, or production state was changed.
